scope: Current Ithica lunar bindings, distinct from retained RPG preview selections. Original source IDs, crops and identity confidence remain unchanged.

grit.limits: CA terrain; explicit walkability. Author grit reused as lunar dust.

rock-floor.limits: CA terrain variation. No inferred terrain animation.

flagstone.limits: WFC room floors; an observed constructed surface, with no claimed origin.

cracked-wall.limits: WFC structural boundary. Collision and sockets come from code.

boulder.limits: Ground.Wall in Ithica; the legacy preview also uses this crop as nonblocking scenery.

stairs-up.limits: A readable exit marker. Travel has an explicit time cost.

resident.limits: Reuses the exact colony engineer crop. Profession, suit protection and field role are game data, not publisher identity.

bandit.limits: An uncertain humanoid silhouette. No faction, species, origin or animation is claimed.

wisp.limits: An uncertain effect-like silhouette. Distinct intent and stats; no supernatural explanation is asserted.

crystal.limits: A readable salvage marker. Recovery yields actual carried stock, deposited only on return.

well.limits: An equipment-like marker requiring a paid repair. Original source identity is retained separately.

gate.limits: Blocking object until a restored pump permits cycling the seal; global route validation prevents bypass.

gate-open.limits: Same source mapping as the preview; switches presentation after the seal is opened.

hazard-corruption.limits: The publisher leaf motif is a symbolic overlay, not a claim of lunar plants. Only eligible unprotected cells spread it; no outdoor ordinary fire.

actors: Candidate for a rescued person, field specialist or unidentified movement after silhouette and suit-fit review.
consumables: Possible medical, food, water or protective-supply icon; new items need explicit costs and use rules.
effects: Possible pressure loss, impact, scanning or interference overlay; individual crops do not establish an animation sequence.
environment: Possible habitat deck, hull, rubble or enclosed structure; author sockets, collision and protected approaches explicitly.
equipment: Possible field tool, repair equipment or supply icon after checking the held shape; no weapon family is inferred.
input: Use for a real contextual control prompt. Controller art remains a future idea while gamepad input is absent.
interface: Possible resident condition, work order, stock or site status icon; only implemented states should be labeled active.
needs-review: Unmapped motif: inspect the crop before assigning a lunar prop or UI role; keep publisher identity uncertain.
props: Possible shelter storage, discarded equipment or compartment dressing after scale review; reserve interaction approaches.
symbols-and-assemblies: Possible observed marking or damaged panel; review complete fragments before assembly and avoid inventing a named faction.
technology: Possible life support, power, pump or diagnostic equipment after footprint review; mechanics and animation require code.
typography: Possible alternate display font or observations log; unknown glyphs are not automatically an invented language.
vegetation: Possible enclosed hydroponics or a contained abandoned habitat; exclude ordinary vegetation from outdoor lunar vacuum.
